fusions.name: Sinew and Horn
fusions.desc: Looses 3 arrows at once, spread apart, each dealing 6 damage. Its damage rises 10% per 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%). Holds 4 charges; each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Full-Draw Spring
fusions.desc: Rears back, then springs you up to 8 tiles onto the target and butts it for 12 damage, rising to 1.8 times that from the full 8 tiles.

fusions.name: Ridge Vantage
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

fusions.name: Coiled Haunches
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your next spell deals 30% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
